measurement_method: First equal slot only. Cat proxy is largest four-connected bright-neutral region with min RGB >145 and channel spread <75. Signal height is non-cyan cap-to-base extent around active lens median x. Pixel measurements are read-only and are not formal semantic segmentation.
assessment: Selected revision corrects the narrow full-pair silhouette. Cat width is within roughly 5-7% of idle/waiting after signal normalization; whole-pair width is closely matched. Cat remains rounder/taller by the bright-region height proxy. Source and extracted frames were inspected, but final registered atlas transitions have not yet been reviewed.
